facts.supporting_text: I have been involved with child nutrition since 1954, when I became a teacher.

facts.label: statement
facts.supporting_text: As you know, the Child Nutrition reauthorization process gives the Administration and Congress the opportunity to support local schools, parents, and communities to move toward an environment that values and fosters the health of our children.

facts.label: fact
facts.supporting_text: Over 28 million lunches are served each day in the National School Lunch Program.

facts.label: fact
facts.supporting_text: In fiscal year 2003, USDA provided schools with over 705 million in entitlement commodities and $75 million in bonus commodities for their school meal programs.

facts.label: statement
facts.supporting_text: Now, I would yield to our Ranking Member today, my good friend from the State of Michigan, Mr. Kildee.

facts.label: Mr. Kildee involvement year
facts.supporting_text: Well, he got breakfast for 3 years, and I never got a bill.
